title: Shattered Eye Queen
description: A pale woman with long flowing purple hair and multiple yellow eyes covering her face, neck, chest and arms stands before a broken stained-glass window. She wears an ornate purple and gold Victorian gown with eye motifs, holding a shard of glass while tentacles and eyeballs emerge from her head and body.
prompt: A surreal gothic woman with pale skin and long flowing purple hair stands before a shattered stained glass window at sunset. Her face, neck, chest and arms are covered in dozens of realistic yellow and purple eyes. Ornate purple and gold Victorian dress with eye patterns and lace details. Tentacles and eyeballs emerge from her elaborate hairstyle. She holds a triangular shard of broken glass near her face, dramatic cinematic lighting, highly detailed digital painting.
